name: Pointer
description: a damned soul fused with an old wooden road sign: weathered planks nailed to a thin body, one arm a long wooden signpost arm held straight out with a carved hand at its end, a plank name board on his chest painted with the word UP, dusty tan wood and rusty nails, a pale tired face

poses.stand: standing in profile facing right, relaxed, weight on one leg

idle.action: stands, breathes slowly, shifts weight and looks around

walk.action: walks forward unhurried, staying in the same spot in the frame

hiccup.action: flinches back, startled, then settles and nods
